reviews.text: Thank you to Muriel for regularly taking care of our Tasco. She always takes such good care of him and we are really happy with the haircuts and treatments she provides.
First grooming session for Archibald (6 months old, a wire-haired dachshund). I am beyond thrilled with the work that was done. Thank you again!
I brought my two Pomeranians back, who had a lot of knots, and she was able to perfectly manage and adapt to their coats. I highly recommend her!

Muriel has been taking care of my English Cocker Spaniel, Scooby, at Garden Dog for two years now, and I couldn't be happier! She always does a flawless grooming job (I like it nice and short so the fur grows back properly), and the results are always remarkable. Scooby adores Muriel and her little dog, Lola, and I can see how well he's in good hands. Muriel is gentle, affectionate, and very professional. You can truly trust her completely!

I asked for a grooming appointment for my cocker spaniel and specifically asked for no clipping, please. I ended up with a little mess and was practically accused of neglecting him. That lovely lady won't be seeing us again.
P.S.: Cocker spaniels aren't clipped, they're hand-stripped.

My little 18-month-old Bichon Frise, Uno, came from Garden Dog looking absolutely gorgeous! I'm so happy, and I also got some great advice on how to care for him. I was highly recommended to come, and now I know exactly where to go!

Thanks again!

I was delighted to have taken my 9-month-old English Cocker Spaniel to Garden Dog.
Lilo got a beautiful haircut that suited her perfectly.
Murielle, the groomer, was very professional and came highly recommended.
Murielle also offers hand-stripping for Cocker Spaniels, which is something few groomers do these days.
In short, my little girl looks absolutely gorgeous, so I highly recommend them.
Litchi, our Spitz, was very happy with his new haircut. Thank you to the great professional for this work. 🐶 …
Verlaine, my little English Cocker Spaniel, had his first grooming experience and it went very well. I'm delighted with the cut and with the warmer weather coming, he'll be very comfortable!
